expressions.name: Setpoints
expressions.expression:
// MVR setpoints + tuning (edit via staticvar widgets). Temps degC, press psia.
static.runSystem    = 0       // master run enable (0/1)
static.timeIncSec   = 0.00625 // loop dt seconds (160 Hz nominal) -- for in-expr integrators
static.evapPressSet = 14.7    // psia evaporator pressure (monitor)
static.evapTempSet  = 100.0   // degC evaporator boiling temp target (makeup heater)
static.superheatSet = 3.0     // degC blower-inlet superheat target
static.blowerRpmSet = 1500    // rpm blower (production knob)
static.feedRpmSet   = 60      // rpm feedwater pump
static.kpSuper  = 0.5
static.kiSuper  = 0.05
static.kpMakeup = 0.5
static.kiMakeup = 0.05
static.condLevelThresh = 2.5  // V CondLevel switch threshold
static.demisterThresh  = 2.5  // V DemisterWater/Flood threshold
static.maxEvapPress    = 25.0 // psia high-pressure trip
static.maxSteamPress   = 35.0 // psia high-pressure trip
static.minSuperheat    = 0.5  // degC low-superheat (wet vapor) trip
static.maxVaporOut     = 140.0// degC blower-discharge over-temp trip

expressions.name: SteamTables
expressions.expression:
// Saturation temps (Antoine, high range) + superheat. Tsat(P_psia) -> degC.
ep = "AI:EvapPress"
sp = "AI:SteamPress"
epmm = ep * 51.7149
spmm = sp * 51.7149
evapTsat  = 1810.94 / (8.14019 - log(epmm) / 2.302585) - 244.485
steamTsat = 1810.94 / (8.14019 - log(spmm) / 2.302585) - 244.485
static.evapTsat     = evapTsat
static.steamTsat    = steamTsat
static.superheatIn  = "TC:VaporIn"  - evapTsat
static.superheatOut = "TC:VaporOut" - steamTsat
static.deltaT       = steamTsat - evapTsat

expressions.name: Interlocks
expressions.expression:
// Safety interlocks -> heatOK / trip / alarm / HeaterEnable.
ep = "AI:EvapPress"
sp = "AI:SteamPress"
shIn = static.superheatIn
vout = "TC:VaporOut"
flood = "AI:DemisterFlood" > static.demisterThresh
trip = 0
trip = trip or (ep > static.maxEvapPress)
trip = trip or (sp > static.maxSteamPress)
trip = trip or (vout > static.maxVaporOut)
trip = trip or flood
trip = trip or (static.runSystem and (shIn < static.minSuperheat))
static.trip = trip
heatOK = static.runSystem and (trip == 0)
static.heatOK = heatOK
"DO:HeaterEnable" = heatOK
"DO:Alarm" = trip

expressions.name: SuperheatControl
expressions.expression:
// Superheat heater PI -> AO:SuperHtr (gated by heatOK), clamp+anti-windup.
err = static.superheatSet - static.superheatIn
iPrev = static.superI
i = iPrev
out = 0
if ( static.heatOK ) then
    i = iPrev + static.kiSuper * err * static.timeIncSec
    i = clamp(i, 0, 10)
    out = static.kpSuper * err + i
    if ( out > 10 ) then
        out = 10
        i = iPrev
    endif
    if ( out < 0 ) then
        out = 0
        i = iPrev
    endif
else
    i = 0
endif
static.superI = i
"AO:SuperHtr" = out

expressions.name: MakeupControl
expressions.expression:
// Makeup/boiling heater PI -> AO:MakeupHtr (gated by heatOK).
err = static.evapTempSet - "TC:EvapTemp"
iPrev = static.makeupI
i = iPrev
out = 0
if ( static.heatOK ) then
    i = iPrev + static.kiMakeup * err * static.timeIncSec
    i = clamp(i, 0, 10)
    out = static.kpMakeup * err + i
    if ( out > 10 ) then
        out = 10
        i = iPrev
    endif
    if ( out < 0 ) then
        out = 0
        i = iPrev
    endif
else
    i = 0
endif
static.makeupI = i
"AO:MakeupHtr" = out

expressions.name: BlowerControl
expressions.expression:
// Blower (VFD) -> production knob; gated by runSystem & not trip. Anti-surge bypass.
run = static.runSystem and (static.trip == 0)
"VFD:VFD 1.ENABLE" = run
if ( run ) then
    "VFD:VFD 1.RPM" = static.blowerRpmSet
    "VFD:VFD 1.DIR" = 0
endif
surge = run and (static.deltaT < 1.0)
"DO:BypassValve" = surge

expressions.name: FeedwaterControl
expressions.expression:
// Feedwater peristaltic (stepper) dosing rate; gated by runSystem & not trip.
run = static.runSystem and (static.trip == 0)
"STEP:Feed.ENABLE" = run
if ( run ) then
    "STEP:Feed.VELOCITY" = static.feedRpmSet
else
    "STEP:Feed.STOP" = 1
endif

expressions.name: CondensatePump
expressions.expression:
// Condensate pump on/off with hysteresis on the CondLevel switch.
lvl = "AI:CondLevel"
on = static.condPumpOn
hi = static.condLevelThresh
lo = static.condLevelThresh - 0.5
if ( lvl > hi ) then
    on = 1
endif
if ( lvl < lo ) then
    on = 0
endif
static.condPumpOn = on
"DO:CondPump" = on

expressions.name: DemisterDrain
expressions.expression:
// Demister: drain whenever liquid water is present.
"DO:DemisterDrain" = "AI:DemisterWater" > static.demisterThresh

expressions.name: monitorMotor
expressions.expression:
// Read the VFD for monitoring/charts.
static.vfdOutVolt = "VFD:VFD 1".VOLTAGE
static.vfdOutAmps = "VFD:VFD 1".CURRENT
static.vfdOutPwr  = "VFD:VFD 1".POWER
static.vfdRpmRead = "VFD:VFD 1".RPM
